exposure: cause of ICU admission (e.g., hypertensive disorders, obstetric haemorrhage, blood transfusion, blood product transfusion, ARDS, HELLP)
cohort: The study included 93 obstetric patients, comprising antenatal and postnatal women within 42 days of delivery, who required ICU admission.
finding: Hypertensive disorders and obstetric haemorrhage were the leading causes of ICU admissions, and maternal mortality was significantly associated with ventilator requirement and higher SOFA scores.
